title: Classify Status
statement: Implement `solve(status)`. Map an HTTP status integer to a billing failure class. 404 returns `not-found`. 408, 429, and any 500 through 599 return `transient`. Every other code returns `billing-failure`. This is the exception class you would raise, named as a string.
hints: The default is billing-failure, including other 4xx codes such as 400.
editorial: Not every failure should retry. 404 is a missing invoice, and retrying it will not create the row. 408, 429, and 5xx are the transient set in this contract. A generic 400 is the caller's bug and stays a billing failure rather than a retry.
